name: GoVisit Agent Skills
tagline: Install 22 read-only skills for travel place and destination discovery
description: The GoVisit Toolkit contains 22 Agent Skills for searching published destinations and places and reading travel details, activities, categories, collections, statistics, and documentation. Each skill includes a JSON contract and calls GoVisit's public read-only HTTP tools without an API key. The public repository is the canonical source for all 22 skills.
